name: LML pair-funded staking rewards claimed against a pumped pair
summary: LML.swapBack() refills the reward contract with LML taken out of the LML/USDT pair (then sync()), and staking sizes LML rewards at a stored price that ignores the live pair. The attacker pumped the pair by buying LML to 0xdead, claimed rewards for 11 pre-staked accounts until swapBack emptied the pair's LML, and sold LML back for the USDT.
notes: Both halves were needed: stored-price rewards stay normal-sized while the pair is pumped, and swapBack pays them by confiscating the pair's LML; the claims took the pair's LML reserve to near zero before the sell. The staking upgrade is the later reset.

LML's reset is MAIN.setTokenAdd(11, LML), the registry pointer through which the reward contract (PROOF.sendMining) calls LML.swapBack(); it was set 78 blocks after LML's deployment. The staking implementation is unverified; its role is read from the exploit trace.
Net USDT depletion of the LML/USDT pair in the single exploit transaction. LML the pair lost (mostly burned to 0xdead by the attacker's own pump) is not valued; no other transaction drained the pair.
